They might want the name of the person who established law and order in ancient Greece. In ancient Greece, the concept of law was developed by various city-states. For example, Draco (Drakos) was a lawgiver in Athens around 7th century BCE, known for harsh laws. Then Solon reformed them. Also, Lycurgus in Sparta.
